why: Find the first departure at or after now in a sorted timetable: after converting HH:MM to minutes, that is bisect_left, the 'first value >= x' search.
hints: Work in minutes since midnight so times compare as numbers.
The next shuttle is the first time t with t >= now. In a sorted list that is index bisect_left(times, now).
If that index is len(times), return "-1"; otherwise format times[i] - now as two-digit HH:MM. O(log n) after the O(n) conversion.
pitfalls: A departure exactly at the current time counts (wait 00:00): bisect_left, not bisect_right.
Pad both hours and minutes to two digits.
